scope: Full statutory audit of Eskom Holdings SOC Limited consolidated financial statements for FY2024.

findings.title: Irregular Expenditure — Prior Year Resolution
findings.description: Prior year qualified opinion on irregular expenditure of R4.2 billion. Remediation programme in progress — expected to be resolved in FY2024 opinion.
findings.recommendation: Complete irregular expenditure remediation programme; strengthen procurement controls.
findings.managementResponse: Eskom engaging with auditors on irregular expenditure remediation and going concern disclosures.
Transnet implementing procurement reform programme and enhanced security measures.

findings.findings: Qualified opinion on prior year comparative figures. Unqualified opinion on FY2024 results. Three management letter points on contract management, export licence compliance, and IT security.
findings.recommendations: Strengthen contract management framework; implement export compliance monitoring system; upgrade IT security controls.
findings.managementResponse: All findings accepted. Contract management policy updated. Export compliance officer appointed. IT security upgrade budgeted for FY2025.

findings.companyName: South African National Roads Agency SOC Limited (SANRAL)
findings.findings: Clean audit opinion. No material findings on financial statements or performance information. One management letter point on minor procurement documentation gaps.
findings.managementResponse: Electronic document management system implemented for procurement records.

findings.companyName: Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA)
findings.findings: Audit in progress. Prior year disclaimer of opinion being addressed through improved financial management and record-keeping.
findings.managementResponse: PRASA implementing comprehensive financial management improvement plan under new CFO.
